change.kind: M5 and M6 of the Manual Read-only Review section rewritten, plus the APPROVE CI precondition sentence; frontmatter, M1-M4, M7, M8 unchanged
not_added: legacy full lint or Japanese-ratio validator

m5_policy: effective required non-empty: unchanged wait_ci_checks.py --required decision (status passed on the current head). Only when wait_ci_checks.py returns no_checks (Ruleset and Classic required inventories both read successfully and empty, and gh pr checks --required reports zero rows) on the current head is the required set proven empty; then ci_verdict_summary.py must exit 0 with status all_pass, no errors, matching head, a non-empty check list whose non-excluded members all succeeded and no failed / pending / stale entries. Inventory errors, 403, API errors, empty CI, pending, failed, cancelled, skipped, stale and ambiguous results never approve. Required settings are not changed.
m6_policy: check_pr_review_gates.py --rule all stays strict and unchanged. In the manual path a g1 / g2 / g6 fail is 'not evaluated (legacy artifact not provided)' only when (i) its minimal_context is an absence-only message (g1 only when no --ci-artifact was passed), (ii) the matching manual evidence is positive (g1: M5, g2: M7, g6: M4), (iii) g4 passes and g3 / g5 do not fail, and (iv) no legacy artifact exists in contradictory or partial form. Such gates are never reported as PASS and are listed in warnings[]. Anything else is a blocker.

runtime_acceptance.rule: AC4 needs the user to type /pr-review-judge <D14 Draft PR number> in an interactive Claude Code session. Fixture results in this manifest are never a runtime PASS; reading the Skill file or an automatic invoke does not substitute.

count_evidence: Measured with pytest --co and a real run; the runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. Behavioural tests run the real helper CLIs (wait_ci_checks.py, ci_verdict_summary.py, check_pr_review_gates.py, allowed_paths_review_gate.py) against a fake gh executable and isolated Git repositories; they verify no live GitHub behaviour.

historical_sync.rule: Only the current pr-review-judge SKILL.md hash / line count and the recorded Manual Read-only Review section (intentional_diff[2]) were synchronized; the D13 test's M6 wording assertions and its mutation helper (replace every occurrence) were updated. source_blob_sha1 / source_sha256 and the D5-time, D8-time and D13-time records are kept (historical_pre_d8 / historical_pre_d13 / historical_pre_d14). The D6, D11 and D13 manifests are unchanged.

rollback: Revert the single D14 PR: it restores the D13 M5 / M6 text, removes this manifest, the D14 test and CI lane, and restores the D5 / D8 current hashes and the D13 test assertions. D13 and earlier history, the strict legacy checker contract, D11 open-pr and the hook-free policy are not modified.
ci_binding: The i4-4d14 job runs this manifest through scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py and the full tests/stage_i4 directory; no new permissions, runner or secrets.
